freeze.difficulty_basis: Static original reference AST: easy <=8 statements/2 branches; medium <=20/5; otherwise hard. Public adapter code excluded. Recorded before subset sampling; no Baseline/Student outcomes.

rules.selection: One verified representative per reviewed component; all components containing historical families reserved to candidates, including replacements for failed historical references; split quotas fixed before execution.
rules.remainder: Largest remainder; workspace wins the 30% tie.
rules.test: Reference/mutation quality checks only; no Baseline/Student performance filtering.
rules.seeds: Routine execution configuration, not user-specified seed values.
